PROTOCOL_INSPECTION_MATCH
Description
Triggered when protocol inspection is matched for this flow.
Examples
In the example, the PROTOCOL_INSPECTION::id array is logged.
when
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION_MATCH
{
set
id
[
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION
::
id
]
log
local0.debug
"inspection id: $id"
}
